intent: Show two real audit-log reads from one test run, both under the same shared login, and answer the regulator question: the log can tell the login, time, service and columns, but not which agent or which customer.

layout.reading_direction: top rows left to right, then the two boxes below

regions.occupies: top 14% of the frame, full width
from about 17% to about 44% of the frame height, FULL width inside the margins
from about 47% to about 56% of the frame height, centred
regions.contains: one amber login pill, joined by a bracket line to both rows above it

regions.occupies: from about 61% to about 93% of the frame height, full width inside the margins
regions.contains: two equal boxes side by side

elements.shape: full-width rounded rectangle card (about 92% of the frame width) with a simple flat outline document icon at its far left, then three cells in one line spread across the card: a monospace time pill, a service name, and a column note; no dividing lines between cells
elements.cells_style: each cell on one line; the column note '5 columns, names and emails' stays on ONE line

elements.shape: full-width rounded rectangle card, same size and same cell positions as row 1, with a simple flat outline document icon at its far left; no dividing lines between cells

wide rounded pill, single line of monospace text, with a simple flat outline key card icon: a plain rounded rectangle with one thick horizontal stripe across it and nothing else (no portrait, no figure, no lines of text) at its left
elements.position: login band, centred horizontally, directly below the two rows
elements.label: novasmart-customer-sa

elements.shape: large rounded rectangle box with a bold heading and one line of text under it
elements.label: Log can tell
elements.sublabel_style: semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), never faint grey

elements.shape: large rounded rectangle box, same size as the left box, with a bold heading and one line of text under it
elements.label: Log cannot tell
elements.sublabel_style: semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), never faint grey

connections.style: one bracket in medium amber: a short line drops from the bottom edge of the lower row card into the top of the pill, and a thin amber line on the right end joins the two rows to that bracket; no label

mandatory: 'novasmart-customer-sa' appears exactly once, on ONE line in a monospace face inside the amber pill; the pill is wide enough that it never wraps
'22:34:10' and '22:34:23' are in a monospace face, each in its own small pill
The two log-row cards are the same size with their cells aligned in the same columns
The left verdict box is soft blue and the right verdict box is soft red; both are the same size
All text in the verdict boxes is semibold near-black, not light grey
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
'5 columns, names and emails' stays on ONE line in its wide cell
prohibitions: NO green anywhere in the image
NO dates, NO 'UTC', NO 'Z' after the times
NO agent names anywhere in the image
NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands or characters
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO identifier broken across two lines (never 'novasmart-' on one line and 'customer-sa' on the next)
NO portrait, face, head or person silhouette inside any icon, including the badge icon
alt_text: The title reads: What the log can tell. Two log rows: 22:34:10, Cloud Run, 5 columns, names and emails; and 22:34:23, Agent Runtime, 7 columns. Both rows connect to one amber login, novasmart-customer-sa. Below, a blue box reads Log can tell: Login, time, service, columns. A red box reads Log cannot tell: Which agent, which customer.
